title: Confidential Executive Compensation, M&A Retention & Workforce Severance Policy

pages.section_heading: 1. Band L7 Principal AI Engineer Equity & M&A Acceleration (HR-COMP-901)
pages.content: CONFIDENTIAL SCHEDULE HR-COMP-901: Principal and Staff AI Engineers classified in Band L7 are eligible for an annual Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) refresh ceiling of EUR 85,000, vesting quarterly over 4 years. In the event of a change-in-control M&A transaction, Band L7 agreements include a 12-month double-trigger vesting acceleration clause and a retention bonus equal to 35% of base salary.

CONFIDENTIAL SCHEDULE HR-SEV-902: In an organizational restructuring or reduction in force, eligible employees receive a severance payout of 1.5 months of base salary per completed year of continuous service, up to a maximum cap of 18 months, plus a fixed EUR 6,000 career outplacement transition stipend.
